critical_code_review_comments: friendlyError() in /app/frontend/src/pages/Thumbnails.jsx is well-layered: status-based (402 quota, 502/503/504 gateway), then network-level (ECONNABORTED/!response), then detail string sniffing for 'origin web server'/'Cloudflare'. Defensive and copy-friendly. ✓

rca of the issue: The Cloudflare 502 from iter37 was transient — root cause was the iter37 GHL test suite restarting backend 4× via supervisorctl. With the suite no longer running, both rewrite-prompt and generate endpoints are stable. The committed fix is the friendlyError helper in Thumbnails.jsx which now masks ANY future 502/503/504 or Cloudflare HTML leak with a warm user-facing message, so even if a transient gateway error recurs, users see 'render server is warming back up' instead of the scary raw Cloudflare copy.
